:::{#thm-negative-imaginary-unit}
#### The number $-i$ also squares to $-1$

$$(-i)^2 = -1.$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: {.content-hidden when-format="revealjs"}

::: proof

$$
\ba
(-i)^2
&= (-1)^2\,i^2
&& \text{(} -i = (-1) \cd i \text{, and } (ab)^2 = a^2 b^2 \text{ because products commute and associate)}
\\
&= 1 \cd (-1)
&& \text{(} (-1)^2 = 1 \text{ and @def-imaginary-unit)}
\\
&= -1
&& \text{(multiply)}
\ea
$$

:::

:::
